about.metaDescription: {brand} is a trading platform: a web terminal, a single client area, identity verification and USDT deposits reconciled on-chain.
about.title: A trading platform <accent>transparent in every operation</accent>
about.subtitle: We build our own trading infrastructure and make it clear to retail traders: real-time quotes, a single client area and verifiable movement of funds.

timeline.text: Registration and single sign-on: one account for the website, the client area and the web terminal.
Identity verification: documents are uploaded in the client area, live trading opens after the check.
USDT (TRC20) deposits: every transfer is reconciled with blockchain data by its transaction hash.
Trading in the web terminal: real-time quotes, demo and live accounts in one interface.
Withdrawals on request from the client area: the payout hash is reconciled on-chain and the status is visible to the client.
